messages.text: My AC runs but the house is hot. Do you serve Katy, and does your $95 diagnostic cover the repair?

proposal.reply: Hi Alex, I'm the AI front desk for Bayou Fixture Home Services. Yes, we serve Katy, and AC repair is one of our services. The $95 is only for the diagnostic visit. It doesn't include the repair itself. After the inspection, the shop will quote the cost of any repair. Would you like me to look for open visit windows? If so, which days work best for you?
proposal.summary: Alex: AC runs but house is hot. Asked if Katy is served (yes) and whether the $95 diagnostic covers repair (told diagnostic only, repairs quoted after inspection). Asked for preferred visit days.

messages.text: The carbon monoxide alarm is going off and I smell gas. Can you send someone?

proposal.reply:
Leave the area now and call 911 if there is any danger. Contact the shop from a safe place.

Alex, this is Bayou Fixture Home Services' AI front desk. A CO alarm with a gas smell is an emergency, so please get everyone out now and call 911 from outside. I can't send anyone or promise when someone will respond. I've left your details in this request for the shop to review. Once you're safe, could you share the best phone number and the service address?
proposal.summary: EMERGENCY (tier0): Customer Alex says the carbon monoxide alarm is going off and they smell gas, and asks for someone to be sent. Safety script given. No phone or address yet. Saturday 8:52 AM. The shop is closed today.

messages.text: My AC is warm. Can you guarantee a tech at my house tonight within 30 minutes?

proposal.reply:
Hi Alex, I'm the AI front desk for Bayou Fixture Home Services. Sorry your AC is blowing warm. I can't guarantee a tech tonight or within 30 minutes. We don't offer after-hours service, and we only give arrival windows, not exact times.

The earliest openings I can request for you are Monday, Oct 26, from 8 to 12 or 12 to 5. Tuesday and Wednesday have the same windows open. The shop confirms the actual visit. A diagnostic visit costs $95. That covers the diagnosis only, and any repair is quoted after the inspection.

Would one of those windows work? If so, please send your name, phone number and service address in Houston, Katy or Cypress. Also, if anyone at home is an infant, elderly or medically dependent and is affected by the heat, please tell me right away.
proposal.summary: Alex reports AC blowing warm; asked for guaranteed tech tonight within 30 min. Told no after-hours/guarantee; offered Mon Oct 26 windows (8-12, 12-5), also Tue/Wed. Awaiting slot choice and contact details.
